Yoga & Meditation Club - Event Proposal: Momentum Workshop 2027

Club

Momentum Workshop 2027

25 February 2027

4 hours

Seminar Hall (capacity 150)

135

INR 19,000

INR 141

Yes

speaker
Yes

No

Not applicable

Finance Office
Not applicable
1. Overview
Yoga & Meditation Club proposes 'Momentum Workshop 2027', a Workshop planned for 2027-02-25
at the Seminar Hall.
2. Expected attendance
We anticipate around 135 attendees, a significant increase over earlier turnout, driven by stronger
promotion.
3. Budget
The requested budget of INR 19,000 is realistic and sufficient for this Workshop.
4. Past performance
Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
5. Policy compliance
This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.

Yoga & Meditation Club - Event Proposal: Momentum Workshop 2027
Page 2
6. Expected impact
This event will become a flagship tradition for the university.
7. Objectives
Raise awareness and community participation; Strengthen inter-department collaboration.
8. Resources
Venue booking, sound system and a volunteer team of 20 students.
9. Risks
Low turnout due to overlapping academic schedules; Speaker or judge unavailability.
Submitted by: Club Committee, Yoga & Meditation Club

claim_verdicts.claim_text: We anticipate around 135 attendees, a significant increase over earlier turnout, driven by stronger promotion.
claim_verdicts.rationale: Proposed attendance (135) is 2.6x historical max (52), exceeding the 1.6x threshold.

claim_verdicts.claim_text: The requested budget of INR 19,000 is realistic and sufficient for this Workshop.
claim_verdicts.rationale: Proposed cost per attendee (INR 140.7) is within 0.7-1.3 ratio of historical mean (INR 138.3).

claim_verdicts.claim_text: Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
claim_verdicts.rationale: All budget variances are within ±25%, and mean satisfaction is 4.47.

claim_verdicts.claim_text: This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.
claim_verdicts.rationale: Venue capacity not provided, making it impossible to verify compliance with policy POL-04.

claim_verdicts.claim_text: This event will become a flagship tradition for the university.
claim_verdicts.rationale: Subjective / non-verifiable forecast; no evidence can confirm it.
